same_law: Occupation restricts one conserved total N in product physical4xphysical4, not a separately designed immobile source model. Supplier and field coordinates identical across every N. Event N1 has exactly one charged core excitation. N2 source sectors include all6 mobile configurations.

operators.J: 2 physical profile-projected currents, -partial H/partial external mode A
operators.S: 3 physical LEFT frame generators; N1 S2=3/4
operators.X: 3 core number-weighted CM coordinates, charge-weighted core dipole=-X
operators.P: two field canonical momenta, NOT site-conditioned
operators.Hdiag: primitive core mass and supplier Hubbard

methods.shifted: shifted(shift=(modeA0,modeA1),uniform=(Ax,Ay,Az)); exact external physical A in body and CM/supplier links
methods.source_to: source_to(target,index0..3), creator from own N to targetN=N+1, identity on actual common field and supplier
methods.density_fourier: complete Gaussian continuum rho(k), exp(-ik.x), not merely site occupation
methods.current_fourier: all3 physical Gaussian CM/supplier bond plus rotational-cloud currents; [H,rho]+k.j=0
methods.cm_current: three analytic -delta H_CM/delta uniformA operators, equal -i[H,X] for core charge=-1

current_distinctions: Uniform physical integrated current includes supplier flow AND core charge flow; CM current alone=-i[H,X] for qcore=-1, whereas velocity=+i[H,X]. The actual2 large CM comparator residual is a recorded prose/probe sign error, corrected explicitly without changing H/current. Mode currents include rotational, nonuniform supplier and CM currents and need not equal uniform CM flow. Noether spin is a different operator. Coupling derivative is not used as current.
actual_consumer: rich_common_mobile_20261014_calculate.py accepts input_json output_json; capture.py accepts run label. Output JSON gives full resolvent4x4 addition/removal G, full retarded2x2 field D, dimensions, raw Gauss, CAR, physical current identities, full-state dynamics and controls. NPZ retains actual normalized initial/prepared/final/reference/current-insertion states, stationary odd state, neutral vacuum and all mobile source columns.
source_G_indices: Serialized addition_ab=<c_a R2 c_bdag>; serialized RAW removal_ab=<c_adag R0 c_b>. Canonical electron G_ab=addition_ab+removal_ba. Sources0,1 at cell0 and2,3 at cell1. Stationary N1 source-response state differs deliberately from locally prepared N1 event state; both are retained in NPZ and never conflated.
receiver: Eight-outcome cell0/1 x oblique physical spin +/- x oblique global field coordinate sign +/- inclusive PVM; sum1 and traces every supplier and field state. Not a source return or charge collision.
field_scope: Two actual divergence-free real3D Gaussian collective profiles with Gaussian initial spatial support. Independent field-only preparation; no autonomous site oscillator, finite-q bulk dispersion, local causal propagation or asymptotic photon packet claim.
controls: links=False removes every supplier/CM link; coupling=False retains hopping but removes all shared-Q current coupling; metric=False removes common spin torque but retains field contact and derived halfspin. Each is a declared comparator law, never the delivered candidate.
unexplained_inputs: Scalar colour/CAR/centre sewing; primitive positive mass, hopping, rigidity and metric; electric quadratic law; rigid Gaussian densities; two fixed translation cells and selected global profiles. No free-space electron/photon or Lorentz-mass closure.
